_about: Plato in English: Benjamin Jowett's complete translation of the dialogues (3rd ed., Oxford, 1892), public domain. One translator's whole Plato. Gutenberg texts are clean and carry Jowett's introductions and analyses; the Internet Archive set is the 1892 Clarendon five-volume collected edition (Royal College of Physicians copy) as raw OCR, kept as the page-citable edition of record and for the general index in vol. 5. Order: Gutenberg > Internet Archive. English only; no Greek. Translator recorded per title. Alcibiades II and Eryxias in Jowett's edition were translated by his secretary Matthew Knight (Jowett says so in the introduction to his second appendix).
